about: Every fixture of the Cursor engine. None was captured from a signed-in run: each is synthetic, written by hand from Cursor's published pages, and says so in its own first line. 'guessed' names what no page shows.

fixtures.shows: init, the input's replay, two assistant lines, a successful result

guessed: the result of a function tool call
the error result of a tool call
fixtures.shows: read, write and function tool calls with their results; a read the tool cut (exceededLimit); a tool error

guessed: the whole terminal error line: Cursor documents no error event
fixtures.shows: an error result whose text sounds like a limit: an engine_error, never a limit
a stream that ends with no terminal line
the three assistant events of --stream-partial-output, which give no draft

lines that must give no draft: not JSON, a forged event, another conversation, duplicate keys, NaN, an unpaired result, a bad call id, two tools in one call, an input with no RFC 8785 text, a user line that is not the replay, a second replay, a second init, an undocumented type, a second result, no session id
initialize, authenticate (cursor_login), session/new, two prompts in one session, a permission request answered reject-once
session/cancel during a prompt; the prompt ends with stopReason cancelled
session/load replays the history as session/update before its answer; then a prompt
the argv of each drive, and argv this lane refuses
